request.text: One tiny webbed foot made of soft water gently taps damp earth. An immediate very light muted wet pat with a delicate liquid plip, ending within 0.12 seconds. Close dry game SFX for frequent footsteps, quieter and lighter than a water blob landing. Exactly one soft foot contact. No walking sequence, repeated steps, squelching mud, squeak, large splash, voice, music, ambience or reverb.
